posts.body:
Hello, I'm working on a RPG Project, this Originally was made on MZ but after see on Retropecctive MV is more Usefull for it, so now i'm want to pass it from MZ to MV, I'm Tried do it for myself but obviously went bad.
So now I'm calling From Help. What can I do for get back to MV?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Most of MV's and MZ's files are compatible with each other.
You can try copying the contents of your data folder from the MZ project to a new MV project. I don't think there's any difference in the formatting of those files, but if you used any new, MZ-specific things (like new event commands or something) they might not load.
If that does work, you can certainly copy all of the audio and image files between the two folders - the only thing you'd leave alone is the js folder.
If that doesn't work, then you just start the project over. You can open the two projects at the same time and copy and paste text and such.
Why is MV more useful partway through your project?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The only real disadvantage of MZ is that a lot more plugins are obfuscated and paid.
and that's it.
in all other things MV and MZ are either identical or MZ has the advantage.
For going back, the main disadvantage is that you'll have to disable one of MZ's greatest advantages - the manual layer control. That manual option changed the structure of the map files even if you didn't use it, so MV can't load MZ-maps directly.
as mentioned above you'll have to manually copy the maps with two editors open. That should pose no problems as long as you never needed to place a B-E tile on the ground or an autotile on a higher layer - but if you did you'll have to find a way around that in MV.
Masterzonic said:
why isn't on MZ. Animation Editor
Click to expand...
It is - it was added later in an update.
just right-click on the animation slot and select "create MV compatible data"
be warned that your project and editor both needs to be updated beyond 1.4 (I think) to support this
